title: The Teaching on Those Who Have Fallen Asleep and the Lord's Return
description: Paul instructs the Thessalonians about those who have fallen asleep, so that they will not grieve like others who have no hope. At the Lord's return, Jesus himself will descend from heaven with a commanding shout, the voice of an archangel, and God's trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first; then we who are alive will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with him. With these words encourage one another.
